_doc: Controlled edition vocabulary, in priority order (when a title carries several, the first one listed wins; the identity of a disc has exactly one edition). 'player_marker' editions are the ones a player's name sits next to (Tour / Team / Signature). prototype and misprint also raise the prototype / stamped_error flags. Deliberately absent: 'proto' (clashes with Innova's Proto Glow plastic) and a bare 'limited'.
